decisions.reason: As a recent launch that extends the firm's traditional craft offer with electronics and fits its stated move toward combining woodcraft with technology, management is likely to continue it and justify the added investment unless clear failure becomes undeniable.

The nativity stable fits the firm's established seasonal portfolio and is easy to defend as part of the core range, but because it likely required less distinctive investment and is less central to the new strategic direction, it is somewhat easier to drop than the others.

The modern incense smoker figurine is close to the existing craft line while also matching the firm's contemporary-design ambition, so management has reason to persist with it and interpret any early weakness as temporary.
